title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Conse

translated_title: 校准那些改变未来的决策：面向多模态大语言模型的在线策略训练后量化
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）能够降低多模态大语言模型的部署成本，但现有校准方法通常基于局部目标重构固定序列。这忽略了自回归反馈机制：由量化引起的token变化会改变前缀，进而改变未来的状态。然而，仅有在线策略覆盖是不够的，因为许多决策失配对未来的生成几乎没有影响。我们提出OnPTQ，一个在当前量化策略所访问的轨迹上进行校准的在线策略框架。在共享前缀上，OnPTQ识别被量化侵蚀的边界，通过简短的反事实推演评估相互竞争的token，并将当前差异与分支后果结合起来构成“决策-后果”风险。该风险优先处理关键状态，同时借助上下文锚定和轨迹刷新来保持多模态行为，并使校准与更新后的策略保持一致。我们进一步推导了决策-后果...（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出OnPTQ在线策略训练后量化框架，通过“决策-后果”风险识别并优先校准那些会真正改变未来生成轨迹的关键量化决策，从而提升多模态大语言模型量化部署后的性能。
en_tdlr: OnPTQ is an on-policy post-training quantization framework that identifies and prioritizes calibrating quantization decisions that actually alter future generation trajectories via a Decision-Consequence risk, improving quantized multimodal large language models.
